description: Lineage of the last linker run. Consumed by the SeforimLibrary build to verify it links against the same sources the linker processed. Populated by the incremental driver (stage 3); null before the first bootstrap.

sefaria.note: Sefaria release tag the linker last processed (pin is stable).

otzaria.note: sha256 of the files_manifest.json the linker last processed. Otzaria has no stable release tag (deleted each run), so the manifest itself is the lineage.
